title: Moving In
setting: 4pm. Two suitcases and a cardboard box at the gate. The watchman is sitting in a plastic chair with a notebook in his lap, a stub of pencil behind one ear. He's been watching you walk back and forth from the auto for six minutes.

beats.beat: doesn't get up. just looks up over his glasses.

beats.prompt: You set down a suitcase. You say:

choices.en: Hello. I'm in 2A. Krishnamurthy uncle's place.

beats.native: ಓ, Krishnamurthy uncle ಹೇಳಿದ್ದರು. Welcome ಸಾರ್. ನನ್ನ ಹೆಸರು Lokesh. ಯಾವುದೇ ತೊಂದರೆ ಇದ್ದರೆ, ನನ್ನ ಹತ್ತಿರ ಬರ್ರೀ.
beats.translit: ō, Krishnamurthy uncle hēḷiddaru. welcome sār. nanna hesaru Lokesh. yāvudē tondare iddare, nanna hattira barrī.
beats.en: Oh, Krishnamurthy uncle told me. Welcome, boss. My name is Lokesh. Any trouble, come to me.
beats.beat: stands up, smaller than he looked sitting

beats.native: Two rules ಸಾರ್. ರಾತ್ರಿ ಹನ್ನೊಂದು ಗಂಟೆಗೆ gate close. ಊರಿಂದ ಯಾರಾದರೂ ಬಂದರೆ ನನಗೆ ಹೇಳಿ.
beats.translit: two rules sār. rātri honnondu gaṇṭege gate close. ūrinda yārādarū bandare nanage hēḷi.
beats.en: Two rules, boss. Eleven pm, gate closes. If anyone visits from your home town, tell me.
beats.beat: taps the notebook — there's a guest log

choices.en: Got it, boss. No trouble from me.

beats.native: ನೀವು engineer ಅಂದ್ರೆ. ಯಾವ company ಸಾರ್?
beats.translit: nīvu engineer andre. yāva company sār?
beats.en: You're an engineer, I heard. Which company, boss?
beats.beat: the rules out of the way, the real interview begins

choices.native: Indiranagar ನಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು startup ಸಾರ್. ಹೊಸದಾಗಿ ಸೇರಿದ್ದೇನೆ.
choices.translit: Indiranagar-nalli ondu startup sār. hosadāgi sēriddēne.
choices.en: A startup in Indiranagar, boss. Just joined.

beats.native: Startup, ha! Bangalore ತುಂಬಾ engineer ಸಾರ್. ಸರಿ, ನಿಮ್ಮ ಬ್ಯಾಗ್ ಕೊಡಿ — ನಾನು ಮೇಲೆ ತೋರಿಸ್ತೀನಿ.
beats.translit: startup, ha! Bangalore tumbā engineer sār. sari, nimma bag koḍi — nānu mēle tōristīni.
beats.en: Startup, ha! Bangalore has too many engineers, boss. Come, give me a bag — I'll show you up.
beats.beat: already lifting the heavier suitcase. you didn't ask. he didn't ask.
